traits.name: Steady
traits.blurb: Keeps a level head. The dead at the wall shake them half as much.

traits.name: Nervous
traits.blurb: Jumpy. The dead at the wall shake them half again as much, and with six or more of them within ten tiles their aim is a tenth worse.

traits.name: Tinkerer
traits.blurb: Good with their hands. Mends walls 30% faster and makes ammo 20% faster.

traits.name: Triage
traits.blurb: Knows what to do first. Bandages 30% faster, and a cure is 10% more likely to work.

traits.name: Sharp-eyed
traits.blurb: Picks a target and hits it. Shots land 8% more often.

traits.name: Steady hands
traits.blurb: Reloads without fumbling, in three quarters of the time.

traits.name: Tough
traits.blurb: Shrugs it off. A claw or a bite is a quarter less likely to leave a wound.

traits.name: Optimist
traits.blurb: Bounces back. Their spirits recover half again as fast.

traits.name: Loyal
traits.blurb: Stands by their people. Aims 4% better beside a friend, and takes a loss half again as hard.

traits.name: Quick learner
traits.blurb: Picks things up. Skills grow half as fast again.
